label: -ung
rule: Always die. Plural -ungen. Not every verb has an -ung noun.

label: -e
rule: A noun from a verb stem with -e is usually die, often with the vowel of the past: aufgeben → die Aufgabe.

label: -t, -ft
rule: A noun from a verb with -t or -ft is usually die: die Fahrt, die Ankunft, die Unterschrift.

label: -in
rule: The woman who does it: always die. Plural -innen.

label: -er
rule: der when it names a person or a tool that does the action. For a woman add -in: die Arbeiterin. Not every noun that ends in -er is der (die Butter, das Fenster): the rule is for nouns made from verbs.

label: bare stem
rule: Mostly der, often with a vowel change. Often there is no -ung form beside it: der Umzug, never Umziehung. Exceptions to learn: das Angebot, das Verbot.

label: -nis
rule: Mostly das. Exceptions to learn include die Erlaubnis, die Kenntnis, die Erkenntnis.
short: mostly; but die Erlaubnis, die Kenntnis

label: das + infinitive
rule: Any infinitive can be a noun: always das, with a capital.

label: -bar
rule: Can be done: lesbar = can be read.

label: -lich
rule: From a verb, often "can be done": verständlich = can be understood.

label: -sam
rule: Tending to: sparsam = tends to save.

label: -ig
rule: Having or showing it: vorsichtig = showing care.
